reasoning_content:
I'm seeing a 404 error on the Vite root path, which makes sense since Vite serves the app entry point rather than an index page. The backend is correctly proxying and transforming the module requests. I'm also noticing that the process list shows only three of the four expected processes — the Vite process seems to be missing from what's displayed.

Let me check if Vite is actually running on port 5173 and verify the full process list to confirm it's still active.

action.command: cd /workspace && echo "=== port 5173 listener ==="; (ss -ltnp 2>/dev/null || netstat -ltnp 2>/dev/null) | grep -E "5173|8000"; echo "=== vite process ==="; ps aux | grep -iE "vite" | grep -v grep | head; echo "=== vite serves app entry + main page (200) ==="; printf "app.ts -> %s\n" "$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' http://localhost:5173/resources/js/app.ts)"; printf "MainPage.vue -> %s\n" "$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' http://localhost:5173/resources/js/pages/MainPage.vue)"; echo "=== page HTML loads vite entry ==="; curl -s http://127.0.0.1:8000/ | grep -oE "<script type=\"module\" src=\"[^\"]+\""
